import os, select, signal, subprocess, sys, time, tty
# Private PTY feeder for kgetch: the candidate shell reads its stdin from the raw slave of a
# pty this helper owns; the helper drips a long valid prefix into the master only after the
# shell is observed blocked in its first read, and times that read from the ESC write to the
# shell's FIRST-DONE marker. The child stays in this session (the pty cannot become its
# controlling terminal) and ignores SIGHUP; the master is closed only after 'char 90' was read.
CHILD = r"""
cd "$1" || exit 1
printf 'FEED-READY\n'
kgetch read > first; printf 'FIRST-DONE\n'
: > rest; i=0
while (( i < 100 )); do
  kgetch read > one; IFS= read -r line < one
  printf '%s\n' "$line" >> rest
  [[ $line == 'char 90' ]] && printf 'GOT-Z\n'
  [[ $line == 'none 0' ]] && break
  i=$((i+1))
done
ones=0 other=''
while IFS= read -r line; do
  if [[ $line == 'char 49' && -z $other ]]; then ones=$((ones+1)); else other+="$line;"; fi
done < rest
if (( ones >= 5 && ones + 2 <= $2 )); then echo ones-after-cap-ok; else echo "ones-bad $ones"; fi > remainder
printf '%s\n' "$other" > tail
"""
shell, where, n, lo, hi = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), int(sys.argv[5])
out, seen, marks = [], b'', {}

def hup_ignored():
    signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, signal.SIG_IGN)

def pump(until, want=None):
    global seen
    while True:
        left = until - time.monotonic()
        if left <= 0 or (want and want in seen):
            return want is None or want in seen
        if select.select([master], [], [], min(left, 0.005))[0]:
            try:
                seen += os.read(master, 4096)
            except OSError:
                return False
            for m in (b'FIRST-DONE', b'GOT-Z'):
                if m in seen and m not in marks:
                    marks[m] = time.monotonic()

master, slave = os.openpty()
tty.setraw(slave)
child = subprocess.Popen([shell, '--noprofile', '--norc', '-c', CHILD, 'kgetch-feed', where, str(n)],
                         stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, close_fds=True, preexec_fn=hup_ignored)
os.close(slave)
deadline = time.monotonic() + 15
ready = False
if pump(deadline, b'FEED-READY'):
    run, last = 0, None
    while run < 5 and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        try:
            state = open('/proc/%d/stat' % child.pid).read().rsplit(')', 1)[1].split()[0]
        except OSError:
            break
        try:
            sc = open('/proc/%d/syscall' % child.pid).read().split()[0]
        except OSError:
            sc = None
        ok = state == 'S' and sc != 'running' and (last is None or sc == last)
        run, last = (run + 1, sc) if ok else (0, None)
        time.sleep(0.02)
    ready = run >= 5
out.append('ready blocked' if ready else 'not-ready')
if ready:
    t_esc = time.monotonic()
    os.write(master, b'\x1b[')
    for i in range(n):
        pump(t_esc + 0.02 * (i + 1))
        os.write(master, b'1')
    pump(time.monotonic() + 0.3)
    os.write(master, b'Z')
    pump(time.monotonic() + 10, b'GOT-Z')
    if b'FIRST-DONE' in marks:
        ms = int((marks[b'FIRST-DONE'] - t_esc) * 1000)
        out.append('first-read window-ok' if lo <= ms <= hi else 'first-read window-bad %d' % ms)
    else:
        out.append('first-read not-observed')
    out.append('got-z' if b'GOT-Z' in marks else 'no-z')
os.close(master)
out.append('master-closed')
try:
    status = child.wait(timeout=10)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    child.kill(); status = child.wait(); out.append('killed-after-timeout')
out.append('child-exit %d' % status)
print('\n'.join(out))
